consequence.statement: A new read-only status subresource field becomes available on Probe resources (containing bindings and their conditions); the schema description states it is under active development and is only populated when the "StatusForConfigurationResources" feature gate is enabled — the evidence states no failure or rejection for existing Probe resources.

assertion.statement: The monitoring.coreos.com/v1 Probe CRD schema gained a new top-level status field (a read-only status subresource with nested bindings[].{group,name,namespace,resource} and bindings[].conditions[].{lastTransitionTime,message,observedGeneration,reason,status,type}) between prometheus-operator 0.85.0 and 0.86.2.
